theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.exists_qFactorial_eq_schurElt_mul {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∃ (P : Polynomial ℤ), ∀ (Q : F), Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ 1 → ∏ m ∈ Finset.range μ.cells.card, (1 - Q ^ (m + 1)) / (1 - Q) = schurElt Q μ * (Q ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.nPart μ * (Polynomial.aeval Q) P)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.aeval_qIntPoly {F : Type u_1} [Field F] {Q : F} (hQ1 : Q ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
(Polynomial.aeval Q) (qIntPoly ℤ m) = (1 - Q ^ m) / (1 - Q)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.hookProd_dvd_qFactorial {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∏ x ∈ μ.cells, qIntPoly R (QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ x) ∣ ∏ m ∈ Finset.range μ.cells.card, qIntPoly R (m + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.div_le_card_filter_dvd_succ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (n : ℕ) :
n / d ≤ {m ∈ Finset.range n | d ∣ m + 1}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.prod_qIntPoly_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (h : ι → ℕ) (M : ℕ) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < h x) (hle : ∀ x ∈ s, h x ≤ M) :
∏ x ∈ s, qIntPoly R (h x) = ∏ d ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, Polynomial.cyclotomic d R ^ {x ∈ s | d ∣ h x}.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.qIntPoly_eq_prod_cyclotomic {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {m M : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) :
qIntPoly R m = ∏ d ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M with d ∣ m, Polynomial.cyclotomic d R

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.qIntPoly (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) :
Polynomial R

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.mul_card_filter_dvd_hook_le (μ : YoungDiagram) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
d * {x ∈ μ.cells | d ∣ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ x}.card ≤ μ.cells.card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.card_filter_dvd_hook (μ : YoungDiagram) (d : ℕ) :
{x ∈ μ.cells | d ∣ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ x}.card = weight (betaSet μ) d

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.row_count (μ : YoungDiagram) {d i : ℕ} (hi : i < μ.colLen 0) :
{j ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen i) | d ∣ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ (i, j)}.card = (gaps (betaSet μ) d (beta μ i)).card

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.gaps_eq_filter (B : Finset ℕ) (d b : ℕ) :
gaps B d b = {c ∈ gaps B 1 b | c % d = b % d}

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.image_cval_row (μ : YoungDiagram) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < μ.colLen 0) :
Finset.image (cval μ) (Finset.range (μ.rowLen i)) = gaps (betaSet μ) 1 (beta μ i)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.hook_eq (μ : YoungDiagram) {i j : ℕ} (hj : j < μ.rowLen i) :
QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ (i, j) = beta μ i - cval μ j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.cval_notMem (μ : YoungDiagram) (j : ℕ) :
cval μ j ∉ betaSet μ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.cval_lt_beta (μ : YoungDiagram) {i j : ℕ} (hj : j < μ.rowLen i) :
cval μ j < beta μ i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.cval_strictMono (μ : YoungDiagram) :
StrictMono (cval μ)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.beta_injOn (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Set.InjOn (beta μ) ↑(Finset.range (μ.colLen 0))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.beta_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) {i i' : ℕ} (h : i < i') (hi' : i' < μ.colLen 0) :
beta μ i' < beta μ i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.colLen_le (μ : YoungDiagram) (j : ℕ) :
μ.colLen j ≤ μ.colLen 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.lt_rowLen_iff (μ : YoungDiagram) (i j : ℕ) :
j < μ.rowLen i ↔ i < μ.colLen j

ℕ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.mul_weight_le {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (B : Finset ℕ) :
d * weight B d ≤ weight B 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.two_mul_sum_beads_one_le (B : Finset ℕ) :
2 * ∑ b ∈ B, (beads B 1 b).card ≤ B.card * (B.card - 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.card_mul_pred_le_two_mul_sum (S : Finset ℕ) :
S.card * (S.card - 1) ≤ 2 * ∑ x ∈ S, x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.abacus_injOn {B : Finset ℕ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
Set.InjOn (fun (b : ℕ) => b % d + d * (beads B d b).card) ↑B

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.beads_ssubset {B : Finset ℕ} {d b b' : ℕ} (hb : b ∈ B) (hlt : b < b') (hm : b % d = b' % d) :
beads B d b ⊂ beads B d b'

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.card_gaps_add_card_beads {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (B : Finset ℕ) (b : ℕ) :
(gaps B d b).card + (beads B d b).card = b / d

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HookDivisibility.card_runnerBelow {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (b : ℕ) :
(runnerBelow d b).card = b / d
